marketDataRefresh.name: Market data refresh
marketDataRefresh.description: Downloads an updated quote for every asset with an active market data provider (per workspace).
marketDataRefresh.disableWarning: Asset prices will no longer be refreshed automatically every day. The "Refresh now" button on the Market Data page stays available.

snapshotRebuild.name: Net worth snapshot rebuild
snapshotRebuild.description: Writes the daily net worth/portfolio snapshot for every workspace.
snapshotRebuild.disableWarning: The net worth history will no longer be updated automatically every day (a data point will be missing for skipped days). The "Recalculate now" button on the Portfolio page stays available.

staleJobReaper.name: Stuck job detector
staleJobReaper.description: Detects jobs left stuck by a worker crash (no terminal state ever reached) and marks them failed — this same mechanism.
staleJobReaper.disableWarning: WARNING: a job stuck by a worker crash (import, AI classification, price refresh, snapshot, Google Sheets export) will no longer be detected automatically and will stay stuck until you intervene manually.

import.name: Import processing
import.description: Parses the file (CSV/PDF) and inserts the transactions, triggered by an import confirmed by the user.

aiClassification.name: AI classification
aiClassification.description: Classifies transactions not recognized by the rules, decoupled from the import job — only starts if an AI profile is active for the workspace.

googleSheetsExport.name: Google Sheets export
googleSheetsExport.description: Exports data to Google Sheets, triggered by an export request from the user — requires the Google integration to be active.

reclassification.name: Reclassification
reclassification.description: Re-runs the classification pipeline (rules, system, optionally AI) on already-imported transactions — triggered by the user after a taxonomy update. Never touches manual corrections.

snapshotBackfill.name: Net worth history rebuild
snapshotBackfill.description: Rebuilds the daily net worth/portfolio history for the requested range (historical prices and FX included) — triggered automatically after an import or manually from the Net Worth page.

positionsRecompute.name: Positions recompute
positionsRecompute.description: Recomputes quantity, average cost and realized P/L of every position from the movements and leaves a report of what changed — started manually from Settings > Maintenance.

readonlyReason.timeout: Requires a worker restart to take effect (read once at startup).
readonlyReason.schedule: Fixed in the worker's code: changing it requires a code change, not just a restart.
